files.section: 地方公共団体と民間との交流（民間→地方）; reference to MHLW employment insurance manual, 2023-10-01 onward, 20352(2)
files.fact: Contains the direct local-government secondment/Article 38 permission/continuing private employment/insurance continuation sentence.

The MHLW manual expressly preserves the originating employer's insured status under the stated Article 38 permission and ongoing employment conditions. Narita's current server timestamp alone is not cutoff-date proof; the independent MEXT 2024 document corroborates the text before cutoff.

files.fact: Article 38 permission allows the private employee to retain private and local-public status concurrently; it does not itself decide unemployment insurance.
